notes.title: Cricket Captain 2019 19.05 Released
notes.content:
We've just released an update for Cricket Captain 2019 on Steam. This is a major update containing an important change to scoring rates which has massively affected the balance of the match engine. 

- Fixed scoring rates for aggressive/defensive batsmen
- Updated database with forum feedback (including franchise 20 ovr squads)
- Fixed Test Match Championship final not being played by user
- Fixed not enough series being played in Test Match Championship (same 9 teams now play)
- Fixed issue with expected rather than actual salary displaying in contracts for squad
- Added free hits to OD friendlies
- Updated Ind FC qualification
- Removed NZ vs Eng from Test Champ
- Fixed 2039 crash

notes.title: Cricket Captain 2019 Version 19.04 released
notes.content:
- Improved contracts AI (team balance, squad size, budget)
- Updated Database
- Fixed English OD final ground issue
- Fixed Indian WC and central contracts squad
- Fixtures screen defaults to current date
- Increased available SA players in SA domestic
- Added change job/team confirmation
- Fixed Eng. FC promotion/relegation message
- Added Ireland vs Zimbabwe series
- Allow overseas players in Eng contracts to be signed when not 100% available.
- Default batting aggression set by match type.
